newsitem.title: USA: Miss. okays Hollywood Boomtown deal.
newsitem.headline: Miss. okays Hollywood Boomtown deal.

text.p: Hollywood Park Inc said on Monday the Mississippi Gaming Commission has approved its merger with casino operator Boomtown Inc.
The deal, announced on April 24, is expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 1997, Hollywood Park said in a statement.

Boomtown owns and operates Boomtown Biloxi, a 33,000 square foot casino with 985 slot machines and 47 gaming tables located in Biloxi, Mississippi. Hollywood Park owns and operates Hollywood Park Race Track and Hollywood Park Casino in Inglewood as well as Turf Paradise Inc in Phoenix, Arizona.
